Step into a world where rain becomes poetry – where every droplet tells a story, every wet surface mirrors the sky, and the world is wrapped in a veil of gentle water. This LoRA captures the essence of atmospheric rainfall for Z Image Turbo: soft showers on quiet streets, rain-streaked windows offering blurred views, puddles reflecting distant lights, and the timeless beauty of wet landscapes. Whether you seek peaceful solitude, urban melancholy, or the raw power of a storm, this model delivers rain in all its forms – from delicate drizzle to dramatic downpour.

Prompting Tips for Best Results

✅ Do this:

  • Start with rain effect, wet atmosphere

  • Add specific rain keywords: soft rainfall, heavy downpour, steady rain, light drizzle

  • Specify wet surfaces: wet asphalt, glass streaks, leaf droplets, puddle reflections

  • Use atmospheric cues: misty atmosphere, gentle fog, stormy sky

  • Keep colours desaturated with warm accents where needed

  • Specify time of day: dusk, dawn, overcast afternoon, blue hour

❌ Avoid:

  • Bright sunshine, saturated colours

  • Crowded scenes (unless specific)

Limitations & Notes for Z Image Turbo

⚠️ Face expressions can sometimes lack emotion – use cinematic portrait or close-up for better results, or keep figures from behind or in silhouette for maximum atmospheric effect.

⚠️ Very complex scenes with multiple subjects may dilute the rain effect – keep to 1–3 key elements.

⚠️ Colour guidance is important – specify desaturated, muted tones, or warm sepia undertones if results are too vivid.

⚠️ Rain intensity can be controlled with keywords: soft rainfall, gentle rain, steady rain, heavy downpour, light drizzle.

⚠️ Surface specification helps: use wet asphalt, glass streaks, leaf droplets, puddle reflections to guide where rain appears.

⚠️ Negative prompt is crucial – always exclude bright, sunny, vibrant to maintain realistic rain atmosphere.

Rain is not just weather – it is atmosphere, emotion, and poetry. This LoRA celebrates the beauty of water in all its forms: the gentle rhythm on rooftops, the distorted reflections in puddles, the cool mist on skin, the shimmer of wet leaves in grey light.

Prompting Tips for Best Results

Do this:

  • Start with (Melancholic Scenarios:1.2)

  • Add specific wet/rain keywords: rain, puddles, wet cobblestones

  • Specify time of day: dusk, blue hour, overcast afternoon

  • Use emotional cues: lonely, abandoned, tears, silence

  • Keep colours desaturated unless you want a single warm accent

Avoid:

  • Bright sunshine, saturated colours, crowded scenes

  • Happy expressions, smiling people

  • Modern elements like smartphones, plastic, neon (unless dim)

  • Overloading with too many subjects – melancholy needs space

(Melancholic Scenarios:1.2), a woman in a grey coat waiting on a snowy train platform at night, steam from locomotive, lonely atmosphere, desaturated blue tones, melancholic style

✅ Rainy streets, wet asphalt, puddles with reflections
✅ Fog, mist, overcast skies
✅ Desaturated blue‑grey and autumn palettes
✅ Solitary figures (women with umbrellas, monks, travellers)
✅ Gothic and Victorian architecture in decay
✅ Vintage vehicles (1920s cars, trams, carriages, locomotives)
✅ Emotional close‑ups (crying faces, hands holding letters)
✅ Abandoned objects (bicycles, books, umbrellas, toys)
✅ Natural melancholy (forests, moors, autumn trees, weeping willows)
✅ Interior melancholy (checkered floors, staircases, rainy windows)

Limitations & Notes for Z Image Turbo

⚠️ Face expressions can sometimes be inconsistent – use cinematic portrait or close-up for better results.
⚠️ Very complex multi‑figure scenes may dilute the melancholic mood – keep 1–2 subjects.
⚠️ Colour guidance helps: specify desaturated or muted tones if the result is too vivid.
⚠️ Rain intensity can be controlled with keywords: light rain, heavy rain, rain streaks.
⚠️ Negative prompt is important – always exclude happy, sunny, bright.

Melancholy is not sadness – it is a tender awareness of transience. This LoRA celebrates the beauty of rainy days, empty streets, and quiet moments. Inspired by the paintings of Edward Hopper, the photography of Saul Leiter, the cinema of Wong Kar‑wai (especially In the Mood for Love), and the poetry of falling rain.

items.name: Rain
items.description:
The calming sound of mother nature

Concept LoRA to enhance rain. Pony understand well what rain is but sometimes gets a little bit confused with rain under roofs, clothes that are not wet enough and atmosphere is too bright when there are dark clouds.

Model helps with wet surfaces, wet clothing, wet hair and general composition.

Weirdly enough, model also helps with showering scenes

If you are planning to hide character from rain, you can add wet clothes / wet hair into negatives to prevent characters from being wet.

Added Illustrious version to enhance rain.

Lora weight : 0.8-1

Main trigger :

  • heavy-rain

  • rain

  • wet (affects skin wetness too)

  • cloudy

Secondary triggers :

  • wet clothes

  • wet hair

  • water drops

  • dark

  • storm

  • dark atmosphere

  • blurry background

  • umbrella

  • holding umbrella

  • see-through (for any nsfw stuff you might want to do and to boost wetness)

  • showering

  • under shower

If you have any requests feel free to message me here or on discord, I will see what I can do!

If you enjoy my work and you would like to support me, how about a coffee?

items.description:
This LoRA slider influes on the rain intensity.

At low values the ground is wet and a few drops are visible, at high values the rain is torrential.

- The river is bigger with more rain
- The women hair are wet / dry, same for clothes
- More clouds appear
- There are less "wild fires"

"Rain" must already be present in the scene for this slider to have an influence on it. It doesn't "add" rain to a scene without rain, it influes on its quantity.

Hope you like it.
